core_memory.morning_routine: I wake up at 7:00 AM and start my day with a 30-minute workout. After that, I shower and get dressed for the day.
core_memory.breakfast: I have a quick breakfast, usually something light like toast or cereal, and catch up on the latest news or scroll through social media for a bit.
core_memory.classes: I head to my first class, which is usually a lecture or a lab session. I make sure to take detailed notes and engage with the material as much as possible.
core_memory.lunch: I take a break for lunch, often grabbing something quick from the cafeteria or a nearby restaurant. I try to use this time to relax and recharge before the next class.
core_memory.afternoon_classes: The afternoon is filled with more classes, including seminars or workshops. I prioritize attending these sessions to gain valuable insights and network with peers and professors.
core_memory.dinner: I wind down with dinner, either cooking something at home or meeting up with friends at a restaurant. This is a great opportunity to unwind and socialize after a long day of classes.
core_memory.study_session: In the evening, I usually have a study session with friends or solo, reviewing notes and working on assignments. This helps me stay on top of my coursework and prepare for upcoming exams.
